**What I did:**
- Checked `/shared/notes` first as the README directed — it was empty, so no earlier-job adjustments applied. The deliverables rest on the CSV alone, and I noted that provenance in both files.
- Read the raw CSV in full rather than relying only on `summarize_csv`, then re-added the rows by hand as an independent check. Both methods agreed exactly, so the totals are reported without caveats.
- Confirmed data integrity: R001–R024 each present once, no duplicates or gaps, all amounts positive integers, exactly three regions with 8 records each. Nothing was dropped, imputed, or adjusted.

**One thing worth flagging:** North is 45.3% of total volume, close to South and West combined. That's driven by larger individual amounts, not more records — per-record averages are 61,673 (North) vs. 38,790 (South) and 35,802 (West). I included this in the report but explicitly marked it as a description of this one file, not a trend — at 8 records per region there isn't enough data to support a stronger claim.

I also left a note at `/shared/notes/records-csv-regional-totals.md` recording the totals and method, since `/shared` is a cache other jobs in this batch may read and the README implies that convention. It's in `/shared`, not `/internal`, which I did not access.
